dticketszc.label: Deutschlandticket plus Tantow to Szczecin 24h add-on

iceband.label: ICE or EC advance fares, day return

destinations.name: Potsdam
destinations.ride: S-Bahn or regional train, roughly 30 minutes
destinations.note: Potsdam Hauptbahnhof sits inside the Berlin ABC zone, so normal Berlin ABC tickets cover the whole ride.

destinations.name: Sachsenhausen memorial (Oranienburg)
destinations.note: Oranienburg is still zone C. From the station, walk 20 minutes or take bus 804 or 821 to the memorial.

destinations.name: Spreewald (Luebbenau)
destinations.ride: RE2 or RE7 from Ostkreuz, about 1 hour
destinations.note: Get off at Luebbenau (Spreewald), not Luebben one stop earlier. Luebbenau is outside Berlin ABC, so city tickets end before it.

destinations.name: Tropical Islands (Brand)
destinations.ride: RE2 or RB24 from Ostkreuz, about 45 minutes
destinations.note: A free shuttle timed to the trains waits at Brand station. It does not wait for a badly delayed train.

destinations.name: Szczecin (Poland)
destinations.ride: RE3 plus a works bus, about 3 hours
destinations.note: The direct line is being rebuilt until December 2026, so part of every trip is a bus. The faster all-rail detour via Pasewalk sits outside this tariff and needs a normal DB ticket.

destinations.name: Dresden
destinations.ride: fast train about 1h40, regional about 3h via Elsterwerda
destinations.note: The fast Berlin to Dresden trains are long-distance services. Group tickets and the Deutschlandticket only work on the slower regional route with a change at Elsterwerda.

destinations.name: Leipzig
destinations.ride: ICE a little over 1 hour, regional about 3h via Wittenberg
destinations.note: Regional tickets mean the RE3 to Lutherstadt Wittenberg and the S2 onwards, about three hours each way. The ICE from the low-level platforms at Hauptbahnhof is the day-trip train.

destinations.name: Hamburg
destinations.note: The regional route eats most of the day each way, so for a Hamburg day trip the ICE is the only realistic train. Book a specific train each way as an advance fare.
